authority.this_delivery: Define the local V0.5 concept, comparison and finite first experiment; do not execute training or change old evidence.

question: Can better use of current and historical feedback improve performance per interaction or reduce work to the same performance, and what additional contribution do explicit reward and punishment make?
claim_scope: Finite engineering cases; no independent-seed inference, formal qualification or universal superiority.

F.null_semantics: Reward field absent from learner input, not a zero-reward TD learner.
F.mechanism: Conditional factual transition memory and goal-directed search; no scalar task-reward update.

feedback_modes.P: Simple feedback and fixed supplemental-practice/local-candidate schedule; raw history and ordinary learning remain enabled.
feedback_modes.S: Same base learner with conditional experience indexing and evidence-directed experiment selection; keep and unknown-probe allowed.

matching.RP_vs_R: Same Q update and initialization; only terminal failure reward changes.
matching.F_vs_reward_channels: Whole-method comparison because the reward-free policy update differs; not a one-scalar causal ablation.

learner_boundary.first_streams: Prospective deterministic engineering coordinates, not formal keyed or iid random streams.
learner_boundary.initial_Q_for_RP_R: Zero task-specific values; no healthy Q* import.
learner_boundary.initial_experience: Empty task-specific history for every arm; common reward-independent nominal action/topology/goal knowledge only.

first_matrix.environment: New versioned small serial-junction rooms; old V03/V04 kernel and captures remain unchanged.
first_matrix.difficulty_variable: Number of sequential decision points only
runtime_manifest_not_yet_written: Exact room coordinates, mirrored layouts and equal-count controller mappings
Common initial state, episode coordinates and immutable observation schema
P fixed candidate cycle and S conditional matching/unknown selection rules
Source inventory, capture path and first-call budget enforcement
first_matrix.manifest_rule: Resolve before first native call from legal task design, not from effect-seeking runs; explicit revision for material changes.

primary: Main successes and failures by prefix
Successful main deliveries against total environment work

target.definition: First main-task index ending a run of 12 consecutive main successes

secondary: Cold versus continued-phase cost including acquired history

planned_total_budget.status: Planned ceiling, not a measured runtime or executable permit

implementation_sequence: One new minimal end-to-end three-channel wiring; real feedback, active learning, failure-only trial and once-consumed experience; no reward leakage into F.
One finite matched matrix, stored result verification and result-neutral interpretation; preserve first failures/partial and do not rerun old native/checkers.

requires: Executed matrix with checkable positive, zero or adverse results
Separate conclusions on feedback organization, punishment and pure-feedback feasibility
does_not_require: General RFL or a large world model
completion.implementation_or_resource_blocker: Preserve and report as blocked/incomplete, not completed evidence.
